account-locked: Ua loka mo sina taimi le teugatupe ona o le tele o taumafaiga lē manuia e ulufale. Faamolemole toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
cloud-customer-email: Tuatusi imeli o le tagata faatau
cloud-panel-not-allowed: O le Cloud Panel e na o le SuperAdmin, i le tomeni o le Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Faatasi ma WeKan i Weddy, o le Cloud Panel e auauna i le tele o tomeni WeKan mai le tasi le server, e tofu ma ana lava faamatalaga. I le tomeni o le Cloud Panel, e pulea e le SuperAdmin tomeni ma CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Faatasi ma se ki CloudFlare API, o se tomeni o loo i ai lona sone i lau tala faaaogā CloudFlare e maua ai se faamaumauga DNS e ui atu i le proxy ma se tusi faamaonia CloudFlare Origin. O isi tomeni e maua ai se tusi faamaonia Let's Encrypt. E teuina le ki i le server ma e le toe faaalia lava.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: E leai se ki CloudFlare API ua teuina: e maua e tomeni uma se tusi faamaonia Let's Encrypt.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Ua teuina se ki CloudFlare API.
error-ldap-login: Ua tupu se sese a o taumafai e ulufale
error-notAuthorized: E lē faatagaina oe e vaai i lenei itulau.
